scope: Persisted RPN projection programs, versioned native causal profile, immutable GGUF bindings and actual CLI generation from the artifact
execution: All matrix row projections execute the deserialized programs. Native normalization, RoPE, attention, residuals and activation remain in the explicitly versioned shared host profile. Programs are never rebuilt on load.

persistence.tokenizer: Persisted BPE vocabulary/policy checked against the identified source and used for encoding/decoding
persistence.relocation: --weights changes only the source locator; expected source identity stays fixed

oracle: One-layer, two-query-head/one-KV-head GGUF: independent uniform-attention closed form for ABA, native equality and prefix/incremental equality. Replacing saved bytecode with Zero and updating its digest changes logits to zero, proving stored execution.
cli: Actual compile/run fixture emits split-byte é, stops at EOS, rejects too-short context, stops at full context and accepts hash-verified relocated weights.
limitations: This is not the complete transformer-to-symbolic-BML translation required by bml-inference-pipeline 8.6.
The legacy scalar-only directory remains a low-level format, and the generation CLI now rejects it with a recompilation instruction.
Fixture tests do not establish performance; the separate real-model evidence records completed generation without a controlled speed comparison.
Runtime decoding/stack limits apply, but manifest and graph limits are not a total RSS budget.
